 News Andhra Pradesh: Class 10 girl attacked with saw inside classroom at Zilla Parishad School in Anantapur 
 Anantapur DSP Ashwin Manideep Kakumanu said the accused attacked the student inside the school classroom Andhra Pradesh: Class 10 girl attacked with saw inside classroom at Zilla Parishad School in Anantapur ANI Updated on :  31 Oct 2026, 11:50 am 
 Copied 
 Anantapur: A Class 10 girl student was allegedly attacked brutally with a saw inside her classroom at a Zilla Parishad High School in Rapthadu, Anantapur district, police said on Saturday.
Anantapur DSP Ashwin Manideep Kakumanu said the accused attacked the student inside the school classroom. 
"An incident of an attack on a Class 10 girl student at a Zilla Parishad High School in Rapthadu, Anantapur district, has been reported. The accused allegedly attacked the student brutally with a saw inside the school classroom," the DSP said. 
Further details are awaited. 
 This report was published from a wire feed. Apart from the headline, the EdexLive Desk has not edited the copy.
